gpu: RTX 5090 sm_120a (GPU 1; GPU 0 held by the pp battery)
bin: /root/target-instr/release/run-gen (instrumented; CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/root/target-instr so the battery's binary was untouched)
why: a model-level exactness or perf number is only evidence if the kernel actually RAN. A refused precondition reads exactly like 'bit-identical to the floor' and 'no perf change', so the count comes first and the conclusion second.

reading: the hook is never even REACHED on this path — entries=0. decode_step_t emits each layer's mixer input directly as q8_1 (rms_norm_q8_1 at nrows=t) and drops the f32 h, so matmul_pre's x_raw_ok guard (x_fallback.len() >= m*in_f) is false and EVERY raw-f32 prefill arm is skipped there, fp8-mmq included. That is pre-existing intended behaviour of the verify class, not a bug in this lane: MEMRA_PREFILL_LOGITS dumps THIS vector, so the prefill-logit instrument built earlier in the lane measures the FLOOR on both arms and cannot see this kernel. Recorded so no later reader mistakes its 0.000e0 for an exactness result.

run: prime path (MEMRA_PP_ONLY=1, prime_cache — the SAME pass the pp512/pp6257 battery times)
reading: the kernel DOES run here, and the ONLY refusal is no_operand=453 — i.e. the tensor had no resident block operand because the stash budget was already spent, exactly the predicted cause. Zero bad_shape, zero bad_scale, zero NaN refusals: no precondition of the kernel itself rejects a single 27B projection. 43/496 = 8.67% of prefill GEMMs, which matches the independent byte-arithmetic prediction (~355 MiB e4m3/layer, BUDGET=3072 MB => a prefix of ~8.6 of 64 layers) to within a rounding step.

consequence: the 27B pp512 medians for the mmq arm are ~8.7%-coverage numbers and must be labeled as such — they are NOT a full-model measurement of this kernel, and ARM A's column is not like-for-like (its scale-fold makes the operand blk=None, which admits it to the MEMRA_ST_E4M3 one-copy arm: no duplicate, no budget, all 64 layers). The full-coverage question is answered instead by the GEMM-only bench (../gemmbench/RESULTS.jsonl), which measures the kernel against the Q8_0 floor at the 27B's own shapes with no budget in the way.
